name: JWT decoder
description: Read what is inside a JSON Web Token. The signature is not checked, so do not treat a decoded token as trusted.

seo.metaTitle: JWT decoder — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Read what is inside a JSON Web Token. The signature is not checked, so do not treat a decoded token as trusted. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/jwt-decode-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: JWT decoder processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/jwt-decode-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does JWT decoder upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. JWT decoder executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/jwt-decode-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate JWT decoder?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/jwt_decode.json or open /tools/jwt-decode?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
